answer: The economy resists sybils by quorum sampling: each verdict comes from a random committee drawn only among established identities whose standing is at stake. Reputation is bonded, so a fake identity starts with zero weight and must buy and age stake before it matters, and every bad ruling burns that stake. An attacker pays the full bond per persona, while each expulsion clips one plume from the flock; the chance any fake raven sways the signal falls multiplicatively with committee size, so attacks grow costlier faster than they scale.
